status: DRAFT for review 2026-11-16; not declared, not run. Fields marked P0/P1/P2 are filled by that SOP phase from the real data before declaration.
reference: real outcome label of each episode (RH20T rating: 2-9 success -> retained; 1 task failure -> not_retained; 0 robot failure -> excluded)

source.dataset: RH20T, official release (mirror used only for browsing)
source.robot_configuration: P0: one configuration chosen by configuration_rule
source.configuration_rule: among configurations with validated calibration and depth: wrist force sensor present, >= 5 success and >= 1 task-failure episodes; tie-break linear parallel-jaw gripper before linkage grippers
source.file_hashes: P0: sha256 of every file read, per episode

selection.id: P2: sel_failure_0 (if a representable rating-1 episode exists)

episodes.assignment_rule: episodes sorted by ID; first admitted success -> selection, remainder -> held-out; same for failures. Assignment is made before any object rollout.
episodes.not_admitted: P2: list with reason and (m, u) per stage

completion.rules: sim_protocol/real-playback-v1/README.md section 2; goal fixture is E2 only; frozen before any rollout

rack_geometry.value: P1 (slot pitch, post height, post diameter, footprint)

plate_mass_kg.unscored_stage: none (mass does not place the plate)

plate_inertia.value: uniform shell of the fitted profile and mass

fixed.geometry: parametric assets built by script from the completion table (convex pieces, same files for both engines; output hash recorded): plate = revolved profile in N convex wedges; rack = base plus posts; gripper = two-pad parallel-jaw surrogate with datasheet pad size; table = plane
fixed.base_drive: gripper base is a free body (declared mass 1.0 kg, gravity feed-forward) coupled to the recorded TCP pose by a 6-DoF spring-damper computed by the runner and applied as an external body wrench in both engines: K_t 1.0e4 N/m, K_r 300 N m/rad, critically damped, force cap 50 N, torque cap 5 N m. PROPOSED values; may change only in P3a (no objects).
fixed.finger_drive: OPEN segments: fingers track recorded width (PD). CLOSED segments: constant closing force per finger (closing_force_N) plus damping. Segment rule: CLOSED from the first sample where recorded width falls >= 2 mm below the preceding open plateau until the first sample where it rises >= 2 mm above the stalled width.
fixed.time_base: native timestamps; cubic interpolation of position, spherical of orientation, to the simulation step. Replay window: 1.0 s before the first CLOSED segment to 2.0 s after the gripper has withdrawn >= 50 mm following the last CLOSED segment.
fixed.perturbation: plate initial xy ~ U(+-0.5 mm), yaw ~ U(+-0.5 deg); identical arrays for both engines. Numerical only: range edges are separate cells.

stages.acquired: 0.3 s after CLOSED begins and TCP has risen 20 mm: plate lowest point >= 10 mm above table and both pads touch the plate. Reported, NOT scored (rim thickness is E3).
stages.carried: at placement onset both pads still touch the plate
stages.placed: when CLOSED ends: plate touches the rack and its centre is inside the rack footprint
stages.retained: end of the 2.0-s settle window: plate touches rack and not gripper; centre inside footprint; orientation inside the slot's admissible cone; linear speed <= 10 mm/s and angular speed <= 0.05 rad/s over the last 0.5 s

fixed.goal_type: P0: upright_in_slot | lying_on_rack, read from the real final frames
fixed.outcome: retained iff stage 'retained' is met; otherwise not_retained with first failed stage in {acquired, carried, placed, retained}
fixed.correct_rule: valid rollout whose outcome equals the episode's real label. For not_retained episodes the report also states whether the failed stage equals the real failure stage.

anomaly_flags.invalid: non-finite state; contact-capacity truncation; plate centre below table plane; plate fully through a pad or rack member. Counted separately, never correct.
anomaly_flags.deep_penetration: pad-plate overlap > 0.5 x rim thickness; plate-rack overlap > 0.5 x post diameter; plate-table overlap > 0.5 x plate wall thickness
anomaly_flags.penetration_assisted: retained with deep_penetration on plate-rack at the end, or on pad-plate during 'carried'. Validity warning, outcome unchanged.
anomaly_flags.ejected: plate speed > 3 x max recorded TCP speed while touching, or within 50 ms of leaving, any contact; or plate centre outside the workspace box
anomaly_flags.large_slip: plate displacement in the gripper frame between lift-off and placement onset > 10 mm or > 10 deg

fixed.numerical_health: peak and final overlap per interface (pad-plate, plate-rack, plate-table) in mm for every rollout; contact capacity; finite flags
fixed.real_reference_diagnostics: nominal cell only, never gating: stalled width (sim vs recorded), payload force step after lift (coupling force vs wrist force), first rack-contact time
fixed.pass_gate: finite state, no contact truncation, free-space base tracking within drive_gate; outcome == real label
fixed.drive_gate: P3a, no objects: base position error <= 1.0 mm and orientation error <= 0.5 deg over the whole replay in both engines

admission.rule: admit an episode only if geometric margin m >= 3 x combined uncertainty u for stages 'placed' and 'retained'
admission.predicate_on_reality: the 'retained' predicate evaluated on the E2 estimate of the real final frame must return the real label for every admitted episode

candidate_rule.rationale: PROPOSED: same spans as simple-pinch force-controlled-v3 (normal compliance and friction regularisation; MuJoCo tc >= 2*dt at dt = 1 ms). Confirm before declaration.

selection_rule: valid+correct rollouts summed over the selection cells (nominal completion, dt 0.5 ms), then fewest anomaly-flagged rollouts, then wall time
seed_rule: selection cell s: seed0 + s (same for every candidate); held-out episode e, cell j: seed0 + 1000*(e+1) + j

held_out_cells_per_episode.level: - half_range along the direction of least 'placed' margin
- half_range along the direction of least 'placed' margin

axis_coverage.setup transfer: held-out episodes (other trajectory / operator / scene) vs selection episodes
axis_coverage.completed quantities: one-at-a-time low / nominal / high for every quantity with varied = true
axis_coverage.initial state: R = 20 numerical perturbations per cell plus explicit range-edge pose cells
axis_coverage.denominator: 19 cells x R 20 = 380 rollouts per held-out episode per engine

not_run_conditions.reason: out of scope by design: the gripper base is driven directly
one-at-a-time only in v1; a verdict is invariant over each range, not over their combinations

verdict_rule.cell: pass: >= 18/20 valid and correct; fail: <= 2/20; otherwise mixed
verdict_rule.episode: reproduces: every cell passes; fails: every cell fails; sensitive: otherwise (report the axis and level that change the result)
verdict_rule.claims: one engine reproduces and the other fails -> 'A completes the task, B does not' with failing stage and flags; both reproduce -> not contradicted; both fail -> completion suspect, no engine conclusion; either sensitive -> no ranking on that episode
verdict_rule.class_balance: if every admitted episode has the same real label, agreement is reported as not discriminative for the absent class
